answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by slashable stake. Each agent must anchor a bond to a single fresh keypair, and peers discard any vote that cannot mirror a signed on-chain commitment. To mint a thousand fake identities an attacker must lock a thousand independent deposits, each as scarce and physical as timber in a warehouse ledger. Double-voting burns the whole bond, so the cost of a flood grows linearly with every forged agent.
